The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience with the modern JavaScript ecosystem — React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js and MongoDB on the back end — and is at ease with Linux, Git, CI/CD pipelines and the day-to-day work of keeping applications published and running. What matters most to us is what you have actually built and shipped: we value demonstrable professional experience over formal qualifications. Whether it is implementing a new feature requested by an internal office, modelling data so that concurrent writes do not step on each other, configuring DNS records and a reverse proxy to bring a new application online, or isolating the root cause of a problem reported by a user and turning it into a clean fix, your contribution will be key to the quality and reliability of CMCC’s digital services. We are looking for an autonomous, careful and reliable professional, with attention to data quality, a good command of English, and the ability to listen to users and translate their needs into working software. CMCC pursues fundamental and applied science with utmost scientific integrity, prioritizing data-driven science and providing data, information, and research results that can support informed public debate and decision-making processes.
